title: Desk permission vocabulary v0
description: Every primitive a plugin or agent can reach, and the scope each one is limited to. Everything not granted is denied.

Permission.description: One permission with its scope. Plugin manifests declare these; bridge calls carry the one that covers them.

FsReadPermission.description: Read files, list folders and watch for changes under the given paths.

FsWritePermission.description: Create, overwrite and delete files under the given paths.

ProcSpawnPermission.description: Start, write to and stop the listed programs, optionally in a PTY.

commands.description: Program names or absolute paths, without arguments.

pty.description: Whether the programs may run in a pseudo-terminal.

NetFetchPermission.description: Make HTTP(S) requests to the listed hosts.

AudioCapturePermission.description: Capture microphone audio, and optionally listen for the wake word.

wakeWord.description: Whether wake-word events may be delivered.

UiSurfacePermission.description: Open and close the surfaces the plugin manifest declares.

PathPattern.description: An absolute path, or one rooted at ~ or at ${plugin}, ${workspace} or ${home}, with forward slashes. * matches within a segment and ** across segments.

HostPattern.description: A host name, optionally with a port, or *. followed by a domain to cover its subdomains.

Command.description: A program name looked up on PATH, or an absolute path. No arguments and no whitespace.
